summary: Implemented the unknown-total speed indicator in rich/progress.py: TaskProgressColumn gained show_speed (default off), a static render_speed method, and a render branch using finished_speed or speed; track() gained show_speed (default True) and passes it to the column; Progress.track now leaves the total as None for unsized iterables instead of raising. Tests: test_task_progress_column_speed added and the two ValueError assertions removed from test_track and test_progress_track. CHANGELOG.md has the new Added line. Nothing was run: tests, mypy, and black are all unverified.
